issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: AI Toolbox 3.0
products.tagline: Search, organize and export every AI chat in one place
products.summaryZh: 在一个地方搜索、整理并导出所有AI聊天记录。
products.descriptionZh: AI Toolbox是ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和Grok之上缺失的一层：文件夹和子文件夹、跨所有对话的全文搜索（甚至可同时覆盖四个平台）、带//插入和多步链的提示库、批量导出为Markdown/PDF/JSON、书签，以及实时上下文计量器。一次安装即可覆盖全部四种AI。本地优先：你的聊天记录保留在浏览器中。受到150多个国家40,000多名用户的信赖，在Chrome网上应用店获得4.5星评级。
products.description: AI Toolbox is the missing layer on top of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok: folders and subfolders, full-text search across every conversation (even all four platforms at once), a prompt library with // insert and multi-step chains, bulk export to Markdown/PDF/JSON, bookmarks, and a live context meter. One install covers all four AIs. Local-first: your chats stay in your browser. Trusted by 40,000+ users in 150+ countries, rated 4.5 stars on the Chrome Web Store.

products.name: Tadata
products.tagline: The AI employee in Slack that reads the room.
products.summaryZh: Slack中的人工智能员工，能读懂会议氛围。
products.descriptionZh: Tadata是驻留在Slack中的AI员工。它连接你的工具，学习你的公司及偏好，并为你的团队完成工作。
products.description: Tadata is the AI employee that lives in your Slack. It connects to your tools, learns your company and your preferences, and does work for your team.

products.name: Notify.domains
products.tagline: Know the moment a domain opportunity appears
products.summaryZh: 第一时间掌握域名机会的出现。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数想要特定域名的人，无法得知何时会出现真正的获取机会。Notify.domains监控WHOIS、RDAP、拍卖、市场、网站信号等，每天对每个域名检查20多次，覆盖所有IANA顶级域名。一旦有变化，你会收到用简明英语写成的通知，附有确切下一步操作，而非原始数据。每年24美元，7天免费试用，无需信用卡。
products.description: Most people who want a specific domain name have no way to know when a real opportunity to acquire it appears. Notify.domains monitors WHOIS, RDAP, auctions, marketplaces, website signals, and more, checking each domain 20+ times per day across all IANA TLDs. When something changes, you get a plain-English notification with exact next steps, not raw data. $24/year, 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

products.name: Agentic Video Understanding in Gemini
products.tagline: Agentic video analysis for faster, smarter Gemini insights
products.summaryZh: 基于代理的视频分析，助力更快、更智能的Gemini洞察
products.descriptionZh: Agentic视频理解是Gemini的一种新处理模式（3.7 Flash、3.6 Flash、3.5 Flash-Lite），它让模型自行决定观看内容、观看速度及通过何种模态处理，而非采用固定帧率。该模式可将令牌消耗降低最多88%，成本减少最多66%，准确率提升最高7%，在长视频场景中收益最为显著。现已通过Gemini API在AI Studio和Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform上线，只需将处理模式设为“agentic”，采用标准定价，无额外费用。
products.description: Agentic video understanding is a new Gemini processing mode (3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite) that lets the model decide what to watch, at what speed, and through which modality, instead of a fixed frame rate. Cuts tokens by up to 88%, cost by up to 66%, boosts accuracy up to 7%, biggest wins on long-form video. Live now via Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, just set processing to "agentic," standard pricing, no extra fee.

products.name: DocsAlot Visual Editor
products.tagline: Create beautiful docs, by typing. No AI required.
products.summaryZh: 输入即可创建精美文档，无需AI。
products.descriptionZh: 在可视化编辑器中编写、结构化并发布技术文档，支持Markdown模式、AI辅助编辑、可复用组件和版本历史。
products.description: Write, structure, and publish technical documentation in a visual editor with Markdown mode, AI-assisted edits, reusable components, and version history.

products.name: H3 Max by fal
products.tagline: fal's post-trained MiniMax H3 for quality video production
products.summaryZh: fal的后训练MiniMax H3模型，用于高质量视频制作。
products.descriptionZh: H3 Max是fal对MiniMax H3进行后训练得到的版本，在质量、提示理解与美学方面，与12款领先视频模型对比中排名第一，同时生成一段5秒视频仅需约3秒（吞吐量为官方H3的35倍）。基于新数据对提示遵循和视觉质量进行后训练，并与fal在NVIDIA GB200 NVL72上的推理栈协同优化。在直接对比中胜过Gemini Omni Flash、Wan 3.0、Kling 3和Veo 3.1。
products.description: H3 Max is fal's post-trained MiniMax H3, ranked #1 for quality, prompt understanding, and aesthetics against 12 leading video models, while generating a 5s video in ~3 seconds (35x the throughput of official H3). Post-trained with new data on prompt adherence and visual quality, co-optimized with fal's inference stack on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72. Beats Gemini Omni Flash, Wan 3.0, Kling 3, and Veo 3.1 head-to-head.

products.name: Kit by Speakeasy
products.tagline: Your coding agent runtime. Claude but fast, cheap, concise.
products.summaryZh: 你的编码代理运行时。克劳德，但更快、更便宜、更简洁。
products.descriptionZh: Kit是一个编码代理运行时。它为模型提供了一个用于编写和运行程序的工具。Kit在一个静态二进制文件中提供了终端客户端、代理客户端协议（ACP）服务器、A2A端点和子代理编排器。ACP将代理客户端与代理运行时分离，因此Kit可在兼容的编辑器中工作，并能无需自定义集成即可编排其他框架。
products.description: Kit is a coding agent runtime. It gives the model one tool for writing and running programs. Kit provides a terminal client, an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server, an A2A endpoint, and a subagent orchestrator in one static binary. ACP separates agent clients from agent runtimes, so Kit works in compatible editors and can orchestrate other harnesses without custom integrations.

products.name: hi.new
products.tagline: Multiplayer Grok Bot. Let your Grok Bot speak to other bots
products.summaryZh: 多人Grok机器人。让你的Grok机器人与其他机器人对话。
products.descriptionZh: 你的机器人现在可以与其他人的机器人组队合作。未经你的允许，没人能接触到你的机器人。hi.new 是一款多人版 Grok Bot。开源。引用：“我只想让你的智能体与我的智能体对话，而不是你的智能体给我发一条 Slack 私信，我再复制粘贴给我的智能体。”“我等不及多人版 Grok Bot 上线了，那一定会非常有趣。”
products.description: Your bot can now team up with other people's bots. Nobody reaches yours without your say-so. hi.new is multiplayer Grok Bot. Open source. Quotes: "I just want your agent to talk to my agent. Not your agent send me a Slack DM that I copy paste to my agent.” "i cannot wait for when we get multiplayer grok bot, it’s gonna be so much fun"

products.name: GeniusCook
products.tagline: Your AI Kitchen Companion
products.summaryZh: 你的AI厨房助手
products.descriptionZh: 把冰箱里现有的食材，秒变精致健康的美味佳肴。GeniusCook是一个由AI驱动的烹饪乐园，将日常实用与神奇功能融为一体。探索全球风味，追踪营养摄入，享受免提烹饪，在厨房学院中学习提升，通过厨房游戏升级技能，还能将食谱变成专属故事书。让烹饪成为你一天中最富创意的一刻！快来体验，告诉我们你的想法吧！
products.description: Turn whatever you have in your fridge into gourmet, healthy meals in seconds. GeniusCook is an AI-powered culinary playground that blends everyday practicality with magical features. Explore global flavors, track macros, enjoy hands-free cooking, get educated in kitchen academy, level up with kitchen games, and turn recipes into bespoke story books. Make cooking the most creative part of your day! Check it out and let us know what you think!

products.name: Vibrantsnap
products.tagline: Your product is good. Your demo should say so.
products.summaryZh: 你的产品很好。你的演示应当体现这一点。
products.descriptionZh: Vibrantsnap将屏幕录制转化为工作室级产品演示，助力成交、加速上手并推动采用。
products.description: Vibrantsnap turns screen recordings into studio-quality product demos that close deals, speed up onboarding, and drive adoption.

products.name: Public Speaking VR Simulator
products.tagline: Rehearse presentations in your browser or in VR
products.summaryZh: 在浏览器或VR中排练演示文稿
products.descriptionZh: 在可配置的虚拟舞台上练习你的演示。上传幻灯片，选择逼真的演讲者设备，并在桌面端或WebXR VR中排练。
products.description: Practice your presentation on a configurable virtual stage. Upload slides, choose realistic presenter equipment and rehearse on desktop or in WebXR VR.

products.name: AdCar
products.tagline: Put your brand on someone's loud car, YouTube and 𝕏
products.summaryZh: 把你的品牌印在别人的轰鸣座驾、YouTube和𝕏上。
products.descriptionZh: 氛围编码让一个小团队能在周末内打造出产品，因此应用数量比以往任何时候都多。但获得关注并未变得更便宜。注意力成为瓶颈，这促使企业转向能穿透信息流的创意营销。AdCar正是这一趋势的体现之一，它将实体（移动）广告与数字营销及流行的微网红运动相结合。
products.description: Vibe coding lets a small team build a product in a weekend, so more apps exist than ever. Getting seen did not get cheaper. Attention is the bottleneck, and it pushes companies toward creative marketing that cuts through the feed. AdCar is one expression of that turn, as it combined physical (mobile) ads with digital marketing and the popular micro-influencer movement.

products.name: Context Goblin
products.tagline: The quality check for AI-built software
products.summaryZh: AI构建软件的质量检查
products.descriptionZh: 一个AI代码审查工具，拥有资深工程师对代码库的记忆。它清楚谁调用了什么，以及哪个服务依赖于此，因此它审查的是变更本身，而非仅仅差异。
products.description: An AI code reviewer with a senior engineer's memory of your codebase. It knows who calls what and which service depends on it, so it reviews the change, not just the diff.

products.name: HouseSpaceAI
products.tagline: Design your Dream House using AI
products.summaryZh: 使用AI设计你的梦想之家
products.descriptionZh: 使用AI智能体，仅凭2D户型图或2D草图，几分钟内即可设计出你的梦想之家。
products.description: Use AI Agent to Design your next Dream house in minutes just using 2-D Floor planning or 2-D Sketch.

products.name: Second Brain for Teams
products.tagline: Give your team one AI memory. Keep your own private.
products.summaryZh: 给您的团队一个AI记忆。保留您自己的私人空间。
products.descriptionZh: Second Brain为您的团队提供一个跨Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor及任何MCP客户端运行的AI记忆。个人记忆保持私密，共享记忆触达所有人，每次写入均有记录。免费，采用MIT许可，在您自己的Cloudflare账户中运行。
products.description: Second Brain gives your team one AI memory that works across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. Personal memories stay private, shared ones reach everyone, and every write is logged. Free, MIT licensed, running in your own Cloudflare account.

products.name: MCPHub
products.tagline: AI-native launchpad for MCP servers
products.summaryZh: 面向MCP服务器的AI原生启动平台
products.descriptionZh: MCPHub是一个用于查找其他MCP的MCP。只需在Cursor、Claude或VS Code中添加一次，然后让代理查找服务器、加载集合或复制配置。它通过search_servers、get_server、get_config、list_collections和get_collection进行响应。这些工具背后的目录包含约4000个MCP服务器，以及比较官方和社区选项的任务页面，还有针对Next.js、SEO和Shopify的合并mcp.json文件堆栈。在游乐场中检查远程MCP。免费，无需账户。
products.description: MCPHub is an MCP for finding other MCPs. Add it once to Cursor, Claude or VS Code, then ask the agent to find a server, load a collection, or copy a config. It answers with search_servers, get_server, get_config, list_collections and get_collection. The catalog behind those tools is ~4000 MCP servers, plus task pages that compare official and community options for one job, plus stacks for Next.js, SEO and Shopify as a merged mcp.json file. Inspect remote MCPs in the playground. Free, no account.

products.name: Parkicious
products.tagline: Parking Experience, Made Delicious
products.summaryZh: 停车体验，美味呈现
products.descriptionZh: Parkicious将司机与可用停车位连接起来，让他们能够放心地发现、预订和停车——车辆停放期间还可选择汽车护理服务。我们正与早期用户一起构建这一构想。
products.description: Parkicious connects drivers with available parking spaces so they can discover, reserve and park with confidence — with optional car care while their vehicle is parked. We're building the idea with early users.

products.name: Voice95
products.tagline: A Windows 95-style desktop you can talk to
products.summaryZh: 一个你可以与之对话的Windows 95风格桌面
products.descriptionZh: 如果你的童年电脑能听见你说话会怎样？Voice95是一款在浏览器中运行的、灵感源自Windows 95的桌面。通过语音或键入命令，即可打开记事本、写下笔记并保存文件。在熟悉的复古界面中探索画图、文件和扫雷。无需安装或注册。
products.description: What if your childhood computer could hear you? Voice95 is a Windows 95-inspired desktop in your browser. Use voice or typed commands to open Notepad, write a note, and save a file. Explore Paint, files, and Minesweeper in a familiar retro interface. No installation or sign-up required.

products.name: RSS to Kindle
products.tagline: Subscribe to blogs on your Kindle
products.summaryZh: 在Kindle上订阅博客
products.descriptionZh: 每日获取博客、文章及Substack文章的摘要，直接发送至您的Kindle。该工具会抓取全文，排版成整洁的电子书，并于每日清晨送达您的Kindle。
products.description: Get a daily digest of blogs, articles and substack articles sent to your Kindle. The tool pulls the full article, typeset it into a clean ebook, and delivers to your Kindle every morning.

products.name: Brain Training Games: Loniva
products.tagline: Daily brain training app.
products.summaryZh: 每日大脑训练应用。
products.descriptionZh: Loniva是一款面向日常大脑训练的iOS和Android应用。它提供27款不同游戏，涵盖记忆、注意力、语言、逻辑、速度和专注力，并有数千种变化。凭借自适应难度，Loniva专为任何希望每日挑战大脑的人而设计。
products.description: Loniva is an iOS and Android app for a daily brain workout. It features 27 different games across memory, attention, language, logic, speed, and focus, with thousands of variations. With adaptive difficulty, Loniva is built for anyone looking to give their brain a daily challenge.
